notes.title: SFX volume slider fixed.
notes.content: The SFX volume slider was previously non-functional. That has been fixed in the latest update.

notes.title: You can now save your progress!
notes.content:
Game now saves your progress when you exit a course halfway through.

"The mechanism" now has consistently synced patterns. Old version required too much waiting if you missed the right cycle.
